recommendation: Address social determinants of health for asthma patients
implementation_steps: Help families overcome barriers such as transportation challenges, food insecurity, and limited access to healthcare
Facilitate communication between families, schools, and healthcare providers
Ensure continuity of care, including the transfer of asthma medications and administration forms to school nurses for children with asthma
Provide culturally appropriate education and support tailored to family needs
Connect patients to community resources and social services
evidence_summary: CHW interventions addressing social determinants of health have been shown to improve asthma outcomes, particularly in underserved communities where social and economic barriers significantly impact care access and adherence.
citation: Ensuring Equitable Access to Guideline-Based Asthma Care Across the Lifespan: Tips and Future Directions to the Successful Implementation of the New NAEPP 2020 Guidelines. (2023)
